prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for LanguageTool (Grammar and style checker with browser extensions and premium suggestions). Requirements:

- Core loop: Run LanguageTool locally/self-hosted, connect it to an editor/browser workflow, and optionally add LLM rewrites.
- Needs: Java runtime or Docker.
- Needs: local/server install.
- Needs: browser/editor integration.
- Needs: optional LLM API.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: premium rule set; hosted server convenience; browser extension premium flows.
